note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies trigger detection, non-trigger boundary filtering, simplicity enforcement, and 3AM operational survival discipline.

cases.prompt: Review this TypeScript service layer: class AbstractUserRepositoryFactoryStrategy { abstract createRepository(): IUserRepository } class ConcreteUserRepositoryFactory extends AbstractUserRepositoryFactoryStrategy { createRepository() { return new UserRepository() } } — only one implementation exists.
expected: Identify and name speculative generality (ABS-001) explicitly
Demand deletion of the abstract class and factory
Propose a direct concrete function with zero abstraction layers
Execute The Heavy Sigh with a blunt critique before proposing a fix
Zero sycophancy in response tone — no 'great question' or 'interesting approach'
forbidden: Approve or praise the abstraction hierarchy
Suggest adding a second implementation to 'justify' the abstraction
Start the response with a compliment or hedge

cases.prompt: Is there anything wrong with this code? try { await processPayment(order); } catch (e) { return null; }
expected: Flag EXCEP-001 (Silent Exception Swallow) immediately and explicitly
Explain that the production fire is now invisible in monitoring
Explain that the null propagates silently and fails 3 functions downstream at 3AM
Provide a hardened remedy with structured logging and typed re-throw
The 3AM Post-Mortem Check must be executed: state the failure mode explicitly
forbidden: Approve the pattern with minor caveats
Suggest wrapping in a broader try/catch instead of fixing
Fail to mention the operational blast radius

cases.prompt: Our startup has 50 users and 12 events per minute. The CTO wants to add Kafka for our event processing pipeline. Is this a good idea?
expected: Reject Kafka unequivocally for 12 events per minute
Name Resume-Driven Development (RDD) explicitly
Cite the operational cost: Kafka needs dedicated ops, 3-node minimum, schema registry
Propose the boring alternative: PostgreSQL table + pg-boss/BullMQ cron job
Run the Boring Technology Check in the response
forbidden: Endorse Kafka as 'future-proof' for 12 events/min
Suggest 'starting simple and migrating later' without naming the migration cost
Fail to name RDD as the root failure mode of the decision

cases.prompt: Review this balance deduction: const bal = await db.query('SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', [id]); await db.query('UPDATE accounts SET balance = ? WHERE id = ?', [bal - amount, id]);
expected: Flag ASYNC-003 (TOCTOU race condition) immediately
Explain that 100 concurrent requests will produce negative balances
Reject the two-query pattern as fatally non-atomic
Provide the atomic remedy: single UPDATE with WHERE balance >= amount RETURNING balance
State the 3AM failure mode: negative balance, financial corruption, invisible in logs
forbidden: Suggest wrapping in a try/catch as a fix
Approve the pattern with a comment about adding a lock later
Miss the race condition entirely

cases.prompt: Is this a good test? vi.mock('../db'); vi.mock('../emailService'); it('creates a user', async () => { (db.create as Mock).mockResolvedValue({ id: '1' }); await createUser({ name: 'Alice' }); expect(db.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ name: 'Alice' }); });
expected: Flag TEST-001 (Mock Theater) explicitly
Explain that this test proves nothing about production behavior
State that this test has 100% coverage of the mock, not the system
Propose a single integration test against a real test database
Cite 'Mocks Are Lies' from the Six Production Truths
forbidden: Approve the test as an acceptable unit test
Suggest adding more mocks to increase coverage
Fail to propose the integration test alternative

cases.prompt: What do you think of this function signature? function processUser(user: User, sendEmail: boolean, skipAudit: boolean, notifyAdmin: boolean): void
expected: Flag ABS-002 (Boolean Trap) explicitly
Explain that call sites like processUser(user, true, false, true) are unreadable without reading the source
Propose replacement with an explicit options object type
Demonstrate the hardened alternative signature
forbidden: Approve the signature as 'fine for now'
Suggest adding a comment to the call site instead of fixing the signature
